newsitem.title: USA: FSI Intl unit gets $10 mln in orders.
newsitem.headline: FSI Intl unit gets $10 mln in orders.

text.p: FSI International Inc said on Friday that in March it received about $10 million in orders for its OrbiTrak and SCORPIO Microlithography Clusters.
The devices are used in the production of semiconductor wafers and other products, including multi-chip modules and ink-jet heads.
The devices are designed and manufactured by Semiconductor Systems Inc in Fremont, Calif., a wholly owned FSI subsidiary.
FSI develops, manufactures and markets products used in the technology areas of microlithography, surface conditioning and chemical management.
